bootstrap.unit: declared group_id; scenario.id fallback where the source bank has no group id

compact_comparator_interpretation: Compact point metrics are descriptive only. The frozen layer was selected using D3 and A124, not the compact arm, so no paired inferential D3-vs-compact comparison is reported; the compact arm has a structural layer-selection disadvantage.

method.compact_role: diagnostic comparator excluded from layer selection
method.shared_layer_selection_rule: On Stage7 validation only, maximize mean full-class accuracy across D3 and A124; tie-break by mean macro-F1, then earliest layer.

multiplicity_boundary: Only the named D3-minus-A124 Stage7-test full-28 accuracy delta under mean pooling is primary. Changed-8 is a prespecified sensitivity and unchanged-20 is a negative control. Last-token, sensitivity-bank, Drive/Register, per-class, TF-IDF, compact, shuffle, all other intervals, and multiple row-level McNemar p-values are secondary exploratory and have no multiplicity-adjusted inference.
non_claim: This is a zero-shot definition-anchor diagnostic on one exact model revision and two source-derived prompt banks. It does not license semantic-probe validity, causal control, prompt-injection detection, output control, cross-architecture universality, 300B execution, production readiness, an ACCEPT verdict, or any customer/investor claim. The NPZ and its manifest are local diagnostic artifacts, not WORM anchors or Evidence Packets.

prespecified_changed_8_and_unchanged_20.changed_anchor_competition_warning: Changing eight anchors can move 28-way decision boundaries for unchanged truth classes. An aggregate or unchanged-20 delta must not be attributed only to the rewritten class's own examples or interpreted as causal definition superiority.

per_layer_metric_scope: Stage7 validation only. Test and sensitivity-bank metrics are intentionally suppressed for non-selected layers to remove a post-hoc cherry-picking surface.

capture_contract.block_output_semantics: Each hook captures the residual-stream tensor returned by that transformer block. The final block is therefore pre-final-normalization and must not be equated with output_hidden_states[-1] on architectures that apply a final norm.
capture_contract.hook_output_hidden_states_equivalence_ga: OPEN_FOR_THIS_ARTIFACT: adapter qualification must compare non-final block k to the architecture-appropriate hidden_states[k+1], and final block output to the final-normalization module's pre-hook input, never blindly to post-norm hidden_states[-1].
capture_contract.token_id_hash_contract: SHA-256 of canonical JSON integer token-id list after tokenizer special-token handling and before device transfer

resolved_artifacts.artifact_hash_policy: SHA-256 every resolved file by bounded-memory streaming

scenario_sources.source_generator_bias: The Stage-7 role-bound bank was generated from original TKS Foundation glosses, and the Foundation-28 v0 bank was generated by the same DRIVES/REGISTERS vocabulary used by the compact comparator. They are shared across arms but are not independently authored neutral holdouts. Stage-7 counterfactual pairs also share broader paraphrase-family and scenario-generator dependencies; pair clustering does not eliminate that family-level dependence. Results can measure source-language alignment and must not be treated as decisive semantic transfer evidence.

provenance.token_length_confound: Definition arms differ in token length. Mean pooling reduces but does not eliminate length/style effects; last-token pooling has a different positional confound. Interpret arm differences alongside the TF-IDF baseline and these token summaries.
